hits.about: Cubix Residence - a luxury project from Cube Development, a Russian company - a holding company working in the field of building materials production, development and real estate construction. The clubhouse with only 64 flats will be built in an ultra-modern, landscaped and green neighbourhood - JVC. The complex will offer studios and apartments with 1-3 bedrooms, while the 4th and 5th floors of the complex will feature duplexes with private pool and terrace.Among the amenities residents will find a gym, swimming pool, and a co-working area, and there is a play area and pool for children. There is also a garden with walking and jogging paths and seating areas. Each residence is equipped with a smart home system and facial recognition system. There is a concierge, 24-hour security and a car park with charging stations for electric cars. There are cafes, restaurants, supermarkets, schools and medical centres nearby, and a metro station will open in the near future.The vibrant and dynamic JVC neighbourhood is known as one of the most attractive areas in Dubai. It is located close to Mohammed Bin Zayed, Barsha and Al Khali roads. The Mall of the Emirates and Palm Jumeirah are 15 minutes from Cubix Residences, Jumeirah Beach, Dubai Marina and Burj Khalifa can be reached in 20 minutes and Dubai Airport is 30 minutes away.Cubix Residences combines modern architectural and design concepts, functionality and comfort to create a unique destination that will suit couples with children, as well as those seeking well-being and comfort in the epicentre of city life.
hits.title: Cubix Residence
